commit_message: Add ADR0156 campaign controls on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the ADR 0156 AI Studio campaign selection, immutable-plan start, exact installed-model preflight, persisted pause/stop/resume progress, aggregate reporting, and deterministic Visual Validation fixture on top of the current-main campaign core. The existing manual Record current evidence path remains available.

Campaign execution against controlled fixtures follows on this same Draft PR; the active user project is never used implicitly.
